title: Senior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. This isn't just about coding, it's about leading technical initiatives, mentoring rising talent, and solving complex challenges using Python's powerful ecosystem while driving innovation in cloud environments, data processing, and web development.

Key responsibilities:

- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Develop data integration services that accelerate customer onboarding processes.

- Ensure reliability, performance, and support of data infrastructure with solutions aligned to application needs and growth projections.

- Lead the design and implementation of complex Python applications.

- Guide junior developers through comprehensive code reviews and technical mentoring.

- Architect scalable solutions using modern design patterns and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform business requirements into technical specifications.

Requirements:

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL Databases.

- Experience with Microservices and Cloud environments.

- Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Strong understanding of best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns knowledge.

- Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Experience in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong experience with version control.

- Strong experience with Unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage.

- Advanced English proficiency.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;

description:
About the Company

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer, based of Argentina or Brazil, with a strong specialization in C#, software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop and maintain complex .NET / C# based applications, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.

Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.

  • Competitive compensation.

  • Fully remote position, with the opportunity to travel to the US.

  • The chance to work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technologies.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.

Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).

  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.

  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines

title: Principal .net Developer
description:
Project Description:

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver multiple new services for a new front office solution for top tier hedge fund. You'll have all the decision power to influence the architecture decisions and delivery process.

Primary Stack: .Net, Angular, MSSQL, Azure

Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with Portfolio managers and external teams

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

- Develop, test and deploy applications

- L3 support the end users and business

Mandatory Skills Description:

- Fluent English and superb communication skills

- Expertise in computer science, algorithms, data structures, OOD and Design Patterns

- Hands on with distributed and high performance systems architecture

- Experience with databases, data modelling and scaling

- A collaborative and engaging personality, being a joy to work with, and contributing positively to our team culture.

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- Expertise in modern complex frontends in Angular

- Experience with Ag Grid, Glue42

- Experience with Azure

- Experience with investment finance

Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Desenvolvedor de Software Java Senior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.

Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.

Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:

Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.

Se você é um(a) desenvolvedor(a) Java experiente, com mais de 5 anos de prática e conhecimento em Java 8+, esta vaga pode ser ideal para você. Valorizamos profissionais que tenham habilidades técnicas sólidas e estejam comprometidos com o crescimento contínuo. Buscamos pessoas que reconheçam a importância da colaboração e da busca por respostas com colegas. Se você se identifica com esses valores e está preparado para desafios estimulantes, inscreva-se. Estamos ansiosos para receber sua inscrição!

Nosso ambiente de trabalho:

  • Trabalhamos com metodologias ágeis
  • Infraestrutura na AWS
  • Integração contínua com Jenkins, Sonar e Docker
  • Repositórios no GitHub
  • Intellij IDE (Ultimate)
  • Linux (remotamente) e Mac (no escritório)

Desafios que você vai encontrar:

  • Processamento de milhões de registros em curto espaço de tempo
  • Consulta massiva de dados para alta performance
  • Processamento assíncrono de jobs
  • Ambiente de alta concorrência
  • Tunning de funcionalidades do sistema
  • Uso de ferramentas de análise de código e profiling
  • Manutenção de base de código extensa
  • Realizar tudo isso sem quebrar o que já existe

O que você vai usar no dia-a-dia:

  • Java 21
  • Spring MVC
  • Spring Boot
  • VueJS
  • TypeScript
  • Javascript
  • Hibernate
  • Git
  • Oracle e PostgreSQL
  • JUnit 5
  • Mockito 2
  • Redis
  • Selenide
  • Desenvolver APIs utilizando Java e outras tecnologias listadas abaixo.

O que você vai usar ocasionalmente:

  • PL/SQL
  • MongoDB 4.4
  • Ionic com VueJS (Desenvolvimento Mobile)

O que você pode precisar para dar manutenção:

  • JSP
  • Angular JS
  • jQuery

Conhecimentos desejáveis:

  • VueJs
  • Experiência com troubleshooting e análise de logs e performance
  • Otimização de SQLs
  • Kibana/APM

title: Astound Us Open Call for Illustrators
description:
At Astound Us we are Drawn to better. We aim high, to Astound, by being the agency with the best in contemporary children's book illustration, licensing, and commercial art.

We invite freelance illustrators to submit their work to be considered for representation and to join our roster of artists. This is a fully remote role , enabling you to work from anywhere in the world while building your global reputation as an illustrator.

Here at Astound Us we work closely with our artists to ensure career advancements with the right clients, regular creative guidance , storybook development , direct connections with clients suited to your style, strong administrative support and on-time payment .

We would love to review your work, so there's absolutely no cost associated with your submission.

All submissions are processed by our talent scouts at ITSme , and reviewed in conjunction with our Astound agents.

In order to submit your work, please send a collection of images or a link to your online portfolio/ website to along with some information about you. We will review this and get back to you if you are the right fit to become represented by illo.

To find out more about ITSme and our submission process, please visit:

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Service Cloud Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 58531

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar funcionalidades em Apex (triggers, services, batch/queueable/schedulable), garantindo bulkification, testes e respeito aos limites da plataforma.
  • Desenvolver Lightning Web Components (LWC) com arquitetura limpa, performance, consumo de dados via LDS/wire e chamadas @AuraEnabled.
  • Construir e manter integrações (REST/SOAP): callouts com Named Credentials, autenticação (OAuth/JWT), tratamento de erros e observabilidade (logs/monitoramento).
  • Atuar no ecossistema de Service Cloud & Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp, Bots), integrando fluxos de atendimento e automações.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado (debug logs, trace flags, Event Monitoring) e otimizações de performance/consultas.
  • Versionar e implantar com SFDX + Git (branching, code review, qualidade de código).
  • Garantir segurança e compliance (FLS/CRUD, compartilhamento, transações) e produzir documentação técnica de suporte às entregas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Forte experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce (Pleno/Sênior) com foco em Service Cloud.
  • Domínio de Apex, SOQL/SOSL, padrões assíncronos e testes unitários (qualidade e cobertura).
  • Experiência com LWC (JS moderno, componentização, comunicação com Apex).
  • Vivência com Digital Engagement (Chat/Messaging/WhatsApp), incluindo implementação técnica e integração com processos de atendimento.
  • Integrações via API REST/SOAP em Apex (Named Credentials, serialização JSON/XML, tratamento de exceções).
  • Troubleshooting e análise de logs em ambientes produtivos e sandboxes.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de governor limits e estratégias de otimização.
  • Prática com Salesforce DX e Git (pull requests, code review).
  • Certificações: Platform Developer I

CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios.

100% remoto.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Business Analyst (BA)
description:
I am reaching out because we are in need of a new Business Analyst (BA) resource for our team, and I would like to request your support. Below are the details of the profile we are seeking:

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst (BA) to join our team and support initiatives related to our Core Banking systems. This professional will act as a key bridge between business and technology, ensuring clarity of requirements, alignment across teams, and effective delivery of solutions in an Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support Agile ceremonies, including:
  • Daily Scrum (when necessary)
  • Backlog Refinement
  • Sprint Planning
  • Sprint Review
  • Sprint Retrospective (as observer or contributor)
  • Conduct requirements gathering and process analysis
  • Prepare and maintain the product backlog
  • Organize and manage dependencies across teams
  • Validate deliverables to ensure alignment with business needs
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders
  • Leverage JIRA for tracking, documentation, and workflow management

Required Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English
  • Experience with Core Banking systems, including:
  • DDA Accounts
  • Savings Accounts
  • Money Market Accounts
  • Certificates of Deposit (CD)
  • Hands-on experience working in Agile teams
  • Strong knowledge of banking processes and system integration
  • Proven experience with:
  • Requirements gathering
  • Backlog preparation and refinement
  • Dependency management
  • Delivery validation
  • Proficiency with JIRA

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with JHA (Jack Henry & Associates) environment

title: Advogado (a) Sênior | Contencioso Cível Estratégico
description:
QUEM SOMOS


TozziniFreire é um escritório full-service com atuação em 55 áreas do Direito Empresarial. Nosso compromisso com a integridade, a responsabilidade social e diversidade e a inclusão social está expresso em nossa missão e é reforçado diariamente em nosso desempenho.


INOVADORES ATÉ PARA INOVAR

Somos pioneiros no desenvolvimento de um programa de inovação interno, o ThinkFuture, que prepara nossos advogados para as transformações digitais e já é referência jurídica nos assuntos que envolvam tecnologia.


NOSSA ATUAÇÃO

Nossa equipe de contencioso cível estratégico é premiada e reconhecida pelo mercado e pelos principais guias nacionais e internacionais. O time tem vasta experiência nos diferentes setores, incluindo Consumidor, Tech Litigation & Data Privacy, em que assessoramos empresas com grandes relevâncias no mercado.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Para nós, a diversidade é peça fundamental do sucesso. Buscamos advogadas (os) Seniores, com inglês fluente e experiência na área do Contencioso Cível Estratégico.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Profissionais com experiência na área do Contencioso Cível Estratégico;
  • Graduação Superior Completa em Direito;
  • OAB Ativa;
  • Inglês Fluente.

title: Customer Support Specialist (POS)
description:
Provide technical support for HungerRush Point of Sale to ensure the stable operation of

customer hardware and software products. This includes troubleshooting, configuring,

maintaining, supporting, and optimizing all HungerRush Point of Sale products, PC

hardware, software, and communication links. This job requires a technical understanding

of IT, an appreciation of the food industry, and strong customer service skills.

Essential Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Provide first class Technical Support over the phone
  • Identify, analyze, and correct technical and software issues
  • Work customer cases efficiently with the goal of optimizing and improving customer

satisfaction

  • Ensure customers issues are dealt with in a timely fashion
  • Ensure that customer satisfaction is maintained
  • Maintain an available status to provide quick response times for customers calls
  • Work closely with other departments to provide prompt resolutions to customer

issues

Education :

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)
  • Preferred – Associates Degree (or higher)

Experience:

  • Must Have: 1-3 years of experience in computer technology (prior help desk or call center experiences supporting a software product a big plus)
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Technical certifications (examples: Net+, CompTIA A+ or an AAS degree or equivalent)
  • Previous experience working in the hospitality industry
  • Familiarity with POS equipment
  • Bilingual Speaker (preferable) (Spanish/English)

What You Need For This Position:

  • Be flexible with working schedules, including nights and weekends
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills
  • Be able to technically troubleshoot and reverse engineer:

1. Windows

2. Networking

3. SQL Server (preferred)

title: Senior Front-end Developer (React.js) - Project
description:
We are looking for a remote, skilled Senior Front-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React.js to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping ideas and user feedback into delightful experiences, developing and implementing user interface components into the latest React.js concepts and workflows, and leading the engineering efforts for user-facing features. title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.

Key responsibilities:

- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.

Requirements:

- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

description:
*ROLE BASED IN IRELAND, MUST BE INTERESTED IN RELOCATION*

Borland Delphi

Web technologies, HTML, DHTML and Javascript

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Position Summary:

We are seeking friendly and motivated Customer Support Specialists to serve our

customers and restaurant owners by providing assistance regarding account management

or order inquiries. This could include changes to their account, minor updates to their

menu, or inquiries about an order

Essential Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Take inbound calls from either the customer or the restaurant.
  • Make outbound calls to customers or restaurants to follow up on acknowledgement errors.
  • Manage incoming tickets generated from email or text via CRM (customer relationship management portal).
  • Return calls for any voicemails that a ticket is generated for Minor troubleshooting product or service problems reported by the customer or the restaurant.
  • Route calls / tickets to appropriate channels if necessary.
  • Facilitate and document accurate correspondence between the restaurant and customers
  • Miscellaneous clerical duties.

Education:

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)

Experience:

  • 6+ months work experience (Internship acceptable)
  • Fluent in English - Bilingual Spanish/English preferred
  • Must be available for evening and weekend shifts
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong critical thinking / problem solving skills
  • Preferred but not required:

title: JR Partnership Programs Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.

Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Talent - Performance Specialist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the Role

The Talent Performance Specialist will transform complex data into strategic insights that directly improve individual performance and operational outcomes across Talent Acquisition, working closely with senior stakeholders to become a strategic analytics reference.

Key Responsibilities:

- Consolidating, validating, and maintaining performance dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.

- Analyzing individual and team performance metrics, identifying trends, outliers, and recurring issues to generate actionable, data-driven insights for Talent Acquisition operations.

- Defining, tracking, and evolving KPIs for existing and new Talent Acquisition roles.

- Partnering with Operations and Automation teams, acting as the main point of contact for dashboard changes, data logic updates, and reporting improvements.

Requirements:

- Experience: 2-4 years as a Performance Analyst, Business Analyst, or Data Analyst.

- Performance Metrics: Experience with individual performance KPIs and operational metrics.

- Data Review: Involvement in data-driven performance review processes.

- Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (complex formulas, data validation, querying).

- Experience consolidating data from multiple sources.

- Analytical Skills: Strong understanding of KPIs, trends, outliers, and performance metrics.

- Language: Advanced proficiency in English.

Desirable Skills:

- Experience with Looker Studio or Databricks.

- Basic to intermediate SQL.

- 4+ years in analytics roles linked to Talent, Operations, or QA.

- Experience in fast-growing or scaling environments.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Content Analyst
description:
Career Opportunity: Content Analyst at Hartwell Companies

Hartwell Companies, a leader in industry innovation and a hub for top-tier talent, is on the lookout for an experienced Content Analyst to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to make an impact in a dynamic, growth-oriented organization.

About Us: Hartwell Companies bring together strategically aligned businesses with a shared commitment to growth, innovation, and positive impact. We are a collective of dynamic enterprises, providing management experience, fresh insights, and resources to nurture each brand under our umbrella.

Position: Content Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Model: Contractor Remote

Working Hours: 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Job Description:

The primary purpose of this role is to plan, coordinate, and execute the content strategy for Hartwell companies, including SONCO Safety Marketplace.

The Content Analyst will ensure all website content is SEO-driven and aligned with Information Architecture (IA) best practices to improve search rankings, organic traffic, and user experience.

This role includes creating product descriptions for new product pages, developing content for all website pages, social media, producing customer success cases, and building alliances with organizations, associations, and LinkedIn communities to generate co-marketing initiatives.

Main Responsibilities

  • Plan, create, and distribute valuable content.
  • Lead the development and optimization of website product pages, ensuring excellent user experience and strong SEO performance.
  • Ensure website content supports the SEO strategy, including keyword targeting, internal linking, and Information Architecture improvements to enhance rankings and crawlability.
  • Collaborate with design, video, and content writing teams to produce high-quality, SEO-driven content.
  • Plan and write customer success stories and blog posts for our website. Conduct customer interviews to gather accurate information and brief the copywriting team effectively.
  • Define and pursue alliances with organizations, associations, and LinkedIn communities for co-marketing initiatives.
  • Review and refine digital ad content to ensure consistency and performance alignment.
  • Develop attractive, original content to attract and retain users.
  • Distribute content across channels (website, social media, email, blog).
  • Own and optimize the customer review process.
  • Support the marketing team by conducting client surveys.
  • Measure, analyze, and present results of content strategy efforts, including SEO and organic performance metrics.

Skills and Competencies required:

  • Exceptional writing and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Advanced skill level in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with WordPress.
  • Knowledge of web publishing requirements and content structuring best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with SEO and web traffic metrics.
  • Understanding of Information Architecture (IA) principles and how content structure impacts SEO and user experience.
  • Strong familiarity with various social media platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to use own initiative to progress work and to work to deadlines.
  • Flexible and creative attitude toward problem-solving.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across business units.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory, with the ability to write and interact with the US-based team.

Other details of the position:

  • Contract type: Full-time consultant.
  • Working hours: 8 hours daily (from 8 am to 5 pm EST).

title: Salesforce OEM Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $3,500 - $4,500 USD


We are seeking an experienced Salesforce OEM Developer to design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce-based products using Salesforce’s OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) platform. This role requires deep expertise in Salesforce application development, second-generation managed packages, and modern Salesforce development practices, including a thorough and practical understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits and how to design within them.


Along with our partner, we are seeking a candidate who combines strong engineering skills with deep Salesforce administrator-level knowledge to deliver secure, performant, and upgrade-safe managed solutions deployed across multiple customer orgs.


Key Responsibilities:

Salesforce OEM & Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce OEM solutions using second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Build scalable, upgrade-safe features aligned with Salesforce OEM and ISV best practices
  • Implement application logic using Apex, SOQL, and SOSL, with careful consideration of platform constraints
  • Design solutions that efficiently operate within Salesforce governor limits, including limits related to CPU time, heap size, queries, DML, and concurrent execution
  • Develop modern user experiences using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and the Lightning framework
  • Ensure package versioning, dependency management, and release processes follow Salesforce standards


Platform Configuration & Administration

  • Apply deep Salesforce admin knowledge to design effective, maintainable configurations that complement custom code
  • Build and maintain Flows (record-triggered, screen flows, orchestration), ensuring automation is performant and governor-limit aware
  • Configure and manage profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, roles, and sharing rules
  • Design and maintain page layouts, Lightning Record Pages, and UI customizations
  • Evaluate and balance declarative vs. programmatic solutions to minimize technical debt and reduce risk of governor limit violations


Source Control & DevOps

  • Use Git for source control, including branching, merging, and pull request workflows
  • Collaborate within CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments (e.g., scratch orgs, packaging orgs, automated testing)
  • Support release management processes for managed packages across multiple versions and customers


Quality & Collaboration

  • Write comprehensive unit tests to ensure high code coverage and validate behavior under governor limit constraints
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex performance and limit-related issues across customer environments
  • Collaborate with product, architecture, QA, and support teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions
  • Contribute to technical documentation and Salesforce OEM best practice guidelines


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience developing on the Salesforce Platform, particularly with hands-on experience with Salesforce OEM development.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs
  • Thorough understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits, including how they impact:

○ Apex execution

○ Flows and declarative automation

○ Bulk processing and data volume

○ Multi-tenant OEM applications

  • Deep Salesforce administrator-level expertise, including:

○ Flow and declarative automation tooling

○ Security and permissions modeling

○ Page layouts and Lightning Record Pages

○ Data modeling and configuration best practices

  • Experience using Git for source control in collaborative development environments
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data access patterns, and scalable design principles
  • Hold a Platform App Builder Certification is a valuable plus!


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build and scale advanced Salesforce OEM products that power multi-tenant enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

  • Maintain and update project schedules, aligning baselines, deadlines, and deliverables.
  • Track budgets, financial forecasts, and cost/variance analysis.
  • Prepare consolidated reports on performance, cost, risk, and status.
  • Support Project Managers to ensure project processes run efficiently.
  • Reconcile invoices and ensure financial data integrity.
  • Monitor compliance with corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and governance.
  • Prepare analytical insights, trends, and indicators for leadership presentations.
  • Track documentation, changes, risks, and issues.
  • Use data proactively to highlight risks and support corrective actions.
  • Provide general PMO support, including data collection and reporting.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years in Project Coordination / PMO / Project Controls.
  • Experience with MS Project (preferred) and schedule management.
  • Strong analytical skills for working with budgets, cost control, and financial analysis.
  • Strong communication, organization, and stakeholder interaction skills.
  • Experience working with cross functional project teams.
  • Experience with change management and process monitoring.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Atualização de versão do sistema operacional Linux, Windows
  • Aplicação de Patches nos servidores.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de scripts em PowerShell;
  • Habilidade para administração do ambiente do Microsoft Active Directory e NPS;
  • Gestão de File Server, Print Server, Radius, Certificate Authority
  • Conhecimento em Cloud (AWS, GCP, OCI, Azure)

  • Possuir ou estar em processo de obtenção de certificações em Windows/Linux/Cloud (AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP);

title: Desenvolvedor Java/ Springboot - Júnior
description:
Pessoa desenvolvedora Backend Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e serviços backend de alta qualidade e eficiência, utilizando Java e SpringBoot.
  • Colaborar com times de frontend e outros stakeholders para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos de negócio e técnicos.
  • Documentar as soluções e práticas adotadas no desenvolvimento.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java.
  • Conhecimento do framework SpringBoot e suas principais bibliotecas e módulos (Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring MVC, etc).
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL) e noSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.
  • Experiência com controle de versão, preferencialmente Git.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD (ex: Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços e em servidores de aplicação leve.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

Join our dynamic Team as a React Developer and drive innovation in a collaborative environment. You'll enhance services, tools, and components within a collaborative Team by driving Agile solutions for internal and external challenges, ensuring top-notch software quality. Become a key player in our Core team, utilizing modern technologies to shape artifacts and support diverse groups, all while ensuring our software reaches new heights of excellence.

Key responsibilities:

- Develop high-quality, maintainable, and scalable user interface components using React.js.

- Work closely with the product and design teams to achieve effective UX.

- Collaborate with other developers on tasks related to front-end and back-end services.

- Conduct performance optimization of applications for maximum speed and scalability.

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the latest React frameworks and libraries.

Requirements:

- 5+ years of experience in React.

- Experience with Typescript.

- Familiarity with caching systems.

- Comfortable working in GMT+2 timezone.

- Fluent Spanish level.

- Intermediate English level.

Benefits:

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

title: iOS Developer
description:
Position: iOS Developer

Contract Length: 12-month contract + extensions

Location: Remote (EST hours)

*This is a PJ contract opportunity working 40 hours a week*

Required Skills

  • Retail and ecommerce experience
  • UI Testing
  • 3+ years of in-depth mobile development - Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, iOS SDK/Frameworks, REST APIs, JSON, GIT
  • Familiarity with CI/CD (e.g. Jenkins, Bamboo, Fastlane) and experience setting up deployment pipelines
  • Strong understanding of the entire iOS development life cycle
  • The app can be active and respond to the user's needs, chilling in the background, or closed by the user or the OS
  • The five states include not running, inactive, active, background, and suspended
  • Tableview and Collectionview
  • Understanding of MVVM and VIPER development patterns
  • Strong understanding of the XCTest and XCUITest framework
  • C1 or C2 level English (professional English)

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working on enterprise or consumer-grade apps and/or payment processing, encryption, etc. preferred
  • Experience working with open-source frameworks like Alamofire, Promisekit, Firebase, Airship, Cuckoo and Adyen
  • Experience with the code signing and distribution process and have used Apple services like universal linking, push notifications and/or Keychain

About the Company

We're looking for an iOS developer who is passionate about building and delivering high quality, highly polished mobile applications. If you strive to find elegant technical solutions to design challenges, enjoy working on mobile devices, and getting the UX/UI right, this is a good match for you. The ideal candidate will build cutting edge consumer facing, data-driven applications, building applications for iOS devices.

About the Role

The ideal candidate will build cutting edge consumer facing, data-driven applications, building applications for iOS devices.

Compensation:

$17/hr to $25/hr USD.

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.

O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com Dados e AWS.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência avançada em AWS e seus principais serviços para engenharia de dados (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.).
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python para manipulação e processamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de orquestração de dados, como Apache Airflow ou AWS Step Functions.
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacional e não relacional (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados).
  • Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).
  • Conhecimento em controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub, Jenkins, ou CodePipeline.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.

Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

#VempraGFT

#VamosVoarJuntos

#ProudToBeGFT

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.

O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com Dados e AWS.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência avançada em AWS e seus principais serviços para engenharia de dados (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.).
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python para manipulação e processamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de orquestração de dados, como Apache Airflow ou AWS Step Functions.
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacional e não relacional (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados).
  • Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).
  • Conhecimento em controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub, Jenkins, ou CodePipeline.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.

Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Auxiliar de suprimentos
description:
Estamos em busca de um Auxiliar de Suprimentos para se juntar à equipe da Construtora Messa em Campo Grande, MS. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e exige atuação presencial.

As principais atividades incluem auxiliar no processo de compras de materiais e serviços a partir de requisições feitas pelas obras; Realizar cotações com fornecedores; Emitir e acompanhar ordens de compra; Acompanhar emissão de notas fiscais das compras e repassar ao setor financeiro para lançamento; Controlar prazos de entrega e conferência de materiais; Apoiar no controle de estoque e organização de documentos do setor.

Qualificações:

  • Cursando Engenharia Civil ou Técnico em Edificações;
  • Organização, proatividade e boa comunicação;
  • Habilidade com Excel.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência na área de suprimentos ou compras;
  • Experiência em empresas do ramo da construção civil.

Remuneração e benefícios:

  • Salário: R$ 2.200
  • Vale Alimentação (via iFood Benefícios)
  • Vale transporte (via iFood Benefícios)
  • Acesso ao Wellhub

Local de trabalho: Campo Grande – MS

title: Back-End Developer (.Net / C#)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Back-End Developer with 5+ years of experience and strong expertise in .NET and C#. This role focuses on ingesting and transforming data from multiple sources, running data validations, and ensuring high data quality across ETL pipelines and backend services. The ideal candidate has experience with APIs, legacy data migrations, and AWS-based data environments. Experience with ECS Fargate, SQS, Kinesis, Firehose, S3, and Apache Iceberg is a plus.

This project has a 3-6 month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.

Responsibilities

  • Receive and process raw data from multiple internal and legacy systems.
  • Design and implement data transformation pipelines that convert incoming data into standardized formats.
  • Develop and maintain .NET / C# services and APIs used for data ingestion and transformation.
  • Build and execute data validation and quality checks to ensure the reliability and accuracy of data pipelines.
  • Support ETL processes, including exporting data from legacy systems and integrating it into modern platforms.
  • Work closely with existing engineers responsible for data migration and integration efforts.
  • Act as a data quality advocate, focusing on validating and testing data flows rather than application UI or front-end functionality.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to improve data consistency, validation processes, and pipeline stability.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering roles.
  • Strong experience with .NET and C# development.
  • Experience developing APIs and backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, ETL processes, and data transformation.
  • Experience implementing data validation and data quality checks.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems or legacy platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS-based data infrastructure and services.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Python for data processing or scripting.
  • Experience working with Apache Iceberg tables for data lake management.
  • Experience with AWS data and streaming services, such as:
  • Amazon ECS Fargate
  • Amazon SQS
  • Amazon Kinesis
  • Amazon Kinesis Firehose
  • Amazon S3

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Machine Learning and Data Science Specialist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

The Machine Learning and Data Science Specialist position focuses on serving as the owner of ML algorithms powering campaign segmentation and targeting systems. This role is central to product success, managing massive systems with millions of data points and ensuring models directly impact business outcomes while optimizing, supervising, and evolving ML pipelines to drive innovation and reliability in critical platform components.

Key responsibilities:

- Optimizing existing machine learning algorithms to improve accuracy and performance.

- Proposing, designing, and implementing new ML features that enhance product capabilities.

- Supervising and monitoring machine learning performance at scale.

- Defining ML requirements and collaborating with engineering and product personnel to bring them to life.

- Handling administrative and organizational duties related to ML initiatives.

Requirements:

- ML Experience: 5+ years of comprehensive experience in Machine Learning, including at least 4 years building end-to-end model development lifecycles (requirements definition, feature discovery, model training/registration, deployment, monitoring, and MLOps).

- Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python, with strong knowledge of data and ML frameworks.

- Statistical Foundation: Solid fundamentals in probability and statistics.

- Business Acumen: Business-minded approach with proven stakeholder management skills — able to define work based on conversations with senior leaders.

- Product Mindset: Product-oriented perspective: designing ML pipelines with direct business impact and thriving in ownership-heavy environments.

- Development Practices: Familiarity with development best practices and navigating complex production codebases.

- Education: Postgraduate degree in Machine Learning or Data Science.

Additional skills preferred:

- Databricks Platform: Experience with Databricks environment.

- ML Explainability: Experience implementing machine learning explainability pipelines.

- Orchestration Tools: Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.

- Marketing Applications: Experience applying machine learning to marketing use cases.

What to expect from us:

- Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Home Office Setup: Complete hardware provision for your workspace.

- Flexible Hours: Design your own work schedule for optimal work-life balance.

- Paid Leave: PTO, parental leave, and other special leaves.

- Professional Development: English classes and Udemy for Business access.

- Financial Benefits: Personal loans with 0% interest following company policies.

- Competitive Compensation: Payment well above market average.

- Growth Opportunities: Develop at the speed of your learning curve.

- Innovation-Driven Environment: Support and resources for professional growth in diverse, multicultural environment.

- Game-Changing Opportunity: Resources to make significant impact in a fast-growing company.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, do not hesitate to apply!

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Community Manager
description:
Você vive futebol no dia a dia, acompanha tendências, transforma lances em conversa e sabe como criar interação real nas redes sociais? O Jogo a Jogo procura um(a) Community Manager para cuidar da relação com a nossa comunidade.

Falamos de esportes e apostas com uma linguagem leve, criativa e próxima do público brasileiro, sem abrir mão de informação, contexto e responsabilidade editorial. Procuramos alguém que saiba equilibrar resenha, timing e leitura de comunidade.

Devido à natureza do calendário esportivo, e em particular para a cobertura da Copa do Mundo durante o período da contratação, é desejável flexibilidade de horário para cobrir online os jogos que serão transmitidos da América do Norte (Canadá, EUA e México).

Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, gosta de futebol para além do placar e entende o valor de construir comunidade — queremos conhecer você.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar e publicar conteúdos diários para Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok e outras redes;
  • Monitorar menções e interagir com o público de forma criativa e respeitosa;
  • Estar atento(a) a trends, memes e momentos do futebol para gerar engajamento;
  • Colaborar com o time editorial para alinhar prognósticos, posts e campanhas;
  • Criar e redigir e-mails de marketing para a base de usuários do Apostas no IG ou em conjunto com os outros projetos e sites do grupo.
  • Acompanhar métricas e propor novas estratégias para aumentar o alcance.
  • Realizar a cobertura online da Copa do Mundo durante o período da contratação, incluindo interações e posts em tempo real sobre os jogos transmitidos da América do Norte (Canadá, EUA e México).

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia com social media ou community management;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas gráficas (Adobe photoshop,Illustrator etc) e edição de vídeo (Capcut,Riverside, After Effects etc);
  • Fluência em português brasileiro (conteúdo voltado para o público do Brasil);
  • Paixão por esportes, especialmente futebol;
  • Escrita criativa e ágil, com domínio de linguagem digital;
  • Organização para lidar com demandas rápidas e calendário editorial;
  • Noções de métricas e ferramentas de gerenciamento de redes sociais e CRM (Hubspot, RD Station, Optimove etc);
  • Disponibilidade e flexibilidade de horário para cobrir eventos e jogos online, em especial durante a Copa do Mundo.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência na gestão de perfis de humor ou entretenimento esportivo;
  • Habilidade para criar memes, reels ou vídeos curtos;
  • Conhecimento de SEO e tendências do universo esportivo online.

Local de Trabalho

Híbrido para quem morar em Porto, Portugal. Remoto para demais localidades.

Modelo de Contratação

Contratação Pessoa Jurídica / MEI

Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se pelo botão do LinkedIn.

Se tiver dúvidas e/ou quiser enviar portfólio adicional, escreva para:

title: Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior
description:
Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior

Local: Fazenda Brasileiro – Teofilândia (BA), Brasil

Quantidade de Vagas: 01

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial

Disponibilidade: Mudança para a região (empresa oferece suporte)

Sobre a Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior para atuar na mina subterrânea , sendo responsável pelo planejamento estratégico e gestão do sistema de ventilação , bem como pelo acompanhamento de sua execução junto à equipe de Infraestrutura, assegurando condições adequadas de qualidade do ar, segurança operacional, conformidade legal e suporte eficiente às atividades de lavra e desenvolvimento da mina.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir a estratégia de ventilação da mina subterrânea, garantindo alinhamento ao plano de negócios, à segurança dos trabalhadores e à sustentabilidade da operação;
  • Desenvolver e revisar projetos de ventilação para mina subterrânea (primária e secundária);
  • Realizar estudos de fluxo de ar, controle de gases, poeiras, temperatura e umidade;
  • Dimensionar ventiladores principais e auxiliares, dutos, portas e reguladores de ventilação;
  • Elaborar e manter atualizados os planos de ventilação da mina;
  • Propor e implementar inovações, melhorias tecnológicas e iniciativas de otimização de custos nos sistemas de ventilação, visando ganhos de produtividade, segurança e sustentabilidade;
  • Analisar riscos críticos relacionados à ventilação, gases, particulados e condições ambientais, apoiando a gestão de riscos operacionais e a tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com geologia, planejamento de mina, produção, manutenção e SSMA;
  • Liderar estudos avançados de ventilação e projetos associados à expansão, aprofundamento ou mudanças de layout da mina, viabilizando tecnicamente novos cenários operacionais com segurança e eficiência.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação Completa em Engenharia;
  • Experiência sólida em ventilação de minas subterrâneas;
  • Vivência com softwares de ventilação (ex.: Ventsim, VentSim Design, VUMA ou similares);
  • Disponibilidade de mudança para Teofilândia, BA;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Ventilação de Minas, Segurança do Trabalho (desejável).

Se você tem interesse em ventilação de mina subterrânea, planejamento e controle da qualidade do ar, atuação em campo e liderança de equipes em um ambiente operacional dinâmico, essa vaga pode ser para você!

title: Human Resources Business Partner Manager (HRBP)
description:
Who we are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we’re on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With innovation and technology at our core, Keeta is expanding rapidly — with over 1,000 employees worldwide — and you can be part of this global journey.

About the position

We are looking for a HRBP Manager to join our HR team in Brazil .

You will report directly to the HR Lead in Brazil and collaborate with a lean, high-impact team responsible for different business lines and strategic projects.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone comfortable operating in high-growth, 0→1 environments , balancing strategy, execution, and stakeholder management.

Job Responsibilities:

Organizational Optimization:

  • Assist business leaders in building an efficient organizational structure for Keeta, facilitating alignment of goals within the management team.
  • Regularly conduct organizational diagnostics to identify key issues and challenges, and proactively follow up on solutions.

Talent Development:

  • Utilize talent review, development, and co-creation facilitation methods to focus on the recruitment, training, development, and advancement of key talents.
  • Provide strong talent pipeline support and help build talent succession plans for business departments.

Culture Implementation:

  • Drive the implementation and promotion of corporate culture and values within the department.
  • Regularly organize employee engagement and care activities to communicate company philosophy and values, strengthening team cohesion and morale.

Strategic Partnership:

  • Gain deep understanding of the business strategy of the international team.
  • Participate in the entire process from strategy formulation to execution, and develop tailored HR plans to achieve both short- and long-term business objectives.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 3 years of HR experience; experience supporting international teams is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate efficiently with international teams and partners.
  • Strong logical thinking and learning ability, solid HR fundamentals, self-driven, curious, and able to work under pressure.

Job Highlights:

  • Opportunity to participate in the building of an international team, broaden your horizons, and work with global talent.
  • Fast-growing business with great personal development potential; work alongside a professional and high-caliber HR team.

Nice to have

  • Experience working in Chinese companies or multicultural, Asia-influenced environments.

Interested in joining Keeta?

Check out our open positions! When applying, your information will be securely stored and may be shared with Keeta and its global affiliates.

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

You will lead a team of 4–7 professionals and work closely with leadership, auditors, and international stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close under BR GAAP and US GAAP
  • Manage intercompany consolidation , eliminations, and reconciliations
  • Oversee the Brazilian tax operation , including direct and indirect tax calculations and statutory filings (SPED, ECF, ECD, etc.)
  • Coordinate the U.S. tax operation with external advisors
  • Manage transfer pricing processes between group entities
  • Lead the external audit process and act as the main point of contact with Big Four auditors
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements within NetSuite
  • Explore the use of AI and automation tools to improve reconciliations, financial close, and variance analysis
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Accounting & Tax team
  • Provide financial insights and reporting to support leadership decision-making

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)
  • 5+ years of corporate experience after Big Four, ideally in high-growth or technology companies
  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S. teams and auditors)
  • Experience leading and developing accounting or tax teams

Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)
  • Familiarity with tax automation tools
  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes
  • Experience optimizing NetSuite workflows, scripts, or dashboards
  • Postgraduate degree or certifications such as CPA or MBA in Finance

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
