title: Technical Product Manager (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.

You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.

You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.

Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Strong fluency in Agile and Scrum, including backlog ownership, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done.
  • Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, issue tracking, and release coordination.
  • Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints.
  • Active user of AI tools and copilots, with a practical focus on improving workflows and engineering productivity.
  • Highly self-managed, with strong ownership and proactive risk identification across concurrent initiatives.
  • Strong empathy and curiosity for customer and partner problems, with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs.
  • Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team’s single point of accountability for quality and progress.
  • Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners.
  • Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
  • Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers.
  • Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
  • Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
  • Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are seeking a skilled and hands-on Data Engineer with proven experience in Databricks, Apache Kafka, and real-time data streaming solutions.

Responsibilities:

- Design and implement scalable data pipelines using Databricks and Kafka

- Build and maintain real-time streaming solutions for high-volume data

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate data flows into broader systems

- Optimize performance and reliability of data processing workflows

- Ensure data quality, lineage, and compliance across streaming and batch pipelines

- Participate in agile development processes and contribute to technical documentation

Mandatory Skills Description:

- +5 years of experience in data engineering roles

- Proven expertise with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, notebooks, performance tuning)

- Strong hands-on experience with Apache Kafka (topics, producers/consumers, schema registry)

- Solid understanding of streaming frameworks (e.g., Spark Structured Streaming, Flink, or similar)

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

- Proficiency in Python or Scala for data pipeline development

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Jenkins) and agile tools (Jira)

- Exposure to data lakehouse architectures and best practices

- Knowledge of data governance, security, and observability

Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Vendedor externo - Advisory
description:
Quem somos nós:

A Skintec é uma empresa referência em tecnologias para medicina estética e bem-estar, com mais de 30 anos de atuação no mercado . Atuamos ao lado de médicos e clínicas que buscam inovação, segurança e resultados consistentes, oferecendo soluções tecnológicas de alto padrão, respaldadas por evidências científicas e certificações internacionais.

Mais do que tecnologia, entregamos suporte especializado, relacionamento de longo prazo e desenvolvimento para nossos parceiros . Nosso time é movido pela Cultura WOW , que valoriza pessoas, excelência e a superação de expectativas.

Skintec — conectando tecnologia, pessoas e excelência médica.


Resumo do desafio:

Realizar venda consultiva, desenvolvendo negócios e gestão de contas, prospectar e realizar a

gestão de carteira de clientes da Skintec, foco em Medical e clientes chave de cada região.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em mercado de luxo e clientes de alto padrão;
  • Vivência anterior com Medical Devices ou corretatos;
  • Forte atuação em negociações de alto ticket e vendas consultivas;
  • Habilidades com CRM.



Condições:

Contratação PJ, estamos trabalhando com pretensões salarias e condições compatíveis do mercado.

title: AI & Innovation Experience Designer
description:
AI & Innovation Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
  • Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
  • Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems
  • Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences
  • Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem


This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

title: Template Designer Intern
description:
Na Cape.io, não estamos apenas acompanhando o ritmo da indústria publicitária. Estamos acelerando-o.


Somos uma empresa global de tecnologia com a missão de eliminar o atrito entre o criativo e a mídia. A Cape.io é a primeira plataforma de Automação Inteligente de Campanhas a unificar todo o ciclo de vida de uma campanha. Ao integrar IA e conformidade (compliance) automatizada desde a concepção criativa até a ativação, capacitamos marcas a lançar campanhas de alto impacto e dentro das normas com velocidade e inteligência sem precedentes.


Nossa plataforma conta com a confiança das principais agências e anunciantes do mundo para controlar e distribuir conteúdo publicitário em mais de 100 países. Com mais de 230 funcionários em 21 escritórios — de Londres às Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico — estamos mudando fundamentalmente a forma como a publicidade funciona.


O que você fará

Como Estagiário(a) de Template Design, você ajudará a criar e otimizar templates para clientes. Você participará de projetos de onboarding criativo e auxiliará no treinamento de novos clientes que utilizam nossa ferramenta self-service de Template Designer. Além disso, você será um ponto de contato para suporte e dúvidas técnicas sobre a ferramenta.

Durante seu estágio, você aprenderá:


  • Como construir templates dinâmicos para diversos clientes globais.
  • Como guiar novos clientes através do processo de onboarding criativo.
  • Como fornecer treinamento especializado e suporte técnico sobre nossa ferramenta de design.


O que você traz (Perfil desejado)

  • Formação: Você está cursando ensino superior ou se formou recentemente em áreas correlatas (Design, Publicidade, Marketing,, etc.).
  • Experiência em Design: Familiaridade com ferramentas como Photoshop, InDesign, Figma ou softwares similares.
  • Familiarizado com Automação: Você gosta de otimizar processos e torná-los mais eficientes através da tecnologia.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Você gosta de interagir com pessoas, dar treinamentos e solucionar dúvidas de clientes.
  • Idiomas: Português nativo e proficiência em Inglês e Espanhol.
  • Atenção aos detalhes: Você tem um olhar apurado para design e garante que todos os templates tenham acabamento profissional.
  • Vontade de crescer: Mentalidade curiosa e motivação para desenvolver novas habilidades técnicas e de atendimento ao cliente.


Sobre nossa solução de automação criativa

  • O desafio: Gargalos criativos e operações manuais de Ad Ops geram sobrecarga nas equipes e prejudicam a performance das campanhas. O ciclo infinito de revisões impede que as marcas escalem o que realmente funciona.
  • Nossa solução: Construímos uma plataforma all-in-one para produzir, personalizar e lançar anúncios de alta performance em todos os canais — de redes sociais e display a vídeo e DOOH. Unificamos os fluxos de criação e mídia, permitindo que marcas passem de um único criativo mestre para variações ilimitadas em minutos.
  • Seu impacto: Você estará no coração da nossa missão de libertar a criatividade. Você capacitará nossos clientes a superar a concorrência através de ferramentas que transformam dados em anúncios personalizados de alto impacto em escala.


Nosso DNA: Como trabalhamos

title: Técnico de Suporte II
description:
Missão do Cargo

Responsável pela manutenção e monitoramento dos ativos de redes, bem como seus serviços, visando a disponibilidade dos recursos (hardware e software) necessários para todo o Grupo Pereira.

Se interessou e faz sentido para você e para a sua carreira? Veja as principais atividades:

• Monitorar a disponibilidade do Data Center garantindo o pleno funcionamento de todos os sistemas de redundância, por meio de rondas diárias e monitoramento on-line;

• Monitorar a performance e disponibilidade de links de comunicação das unidades, e tomar as providências necessárias caso haja falhas ou erros, através da abertura de chamado nas operadoras e/ou substituição/manutenção de ativos danificados, garantindo o restabelecimento da comunicação;

• Auxiliar os usuários no uso correto das ferramentas disponibilizadas pela empresa, por meio de orientação e/ou elaboração de manual técnico;

• Salvaguardar que os procedimentos de monitoramento e segurança de redes sejam cumpridos, por meio das Políticas de redes existente.

O que esperamos do(a) nosso(a) Técnico de Suporte:

• Ensino Superior Completo em Redes de Computadores ou áreas correlatas;

• Conhecimento básico nas ferramentas de monitoramento ZABBIX ou Nagios;

• TCP/IP IPv4 (Noções Básicas);

• Hardware de Servidor (Básico);

• Sistemas Operacionais proprietários e livres (noções básicas);

• Redes wireless (básico);

• Cabeamento Estruturado;

• Configuração de Equipamentos de Interconexão.

O nosso propósito é ser um bom lugar para passar a vida, pensando nisso oferecemos:

• Plano de Saúde;

• Plano Odontológico;

• Seguro de Vida;

• Refeição no Local;

• Vale transporte;

• Suporte Social;

• Descontos especiais para compras em nossas redes.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

• Responsável pela manutenção da IA, através do monitoramento e análises constantes do funcionamento, promovendo a integridade dos sistemas e seus respectivos dados;

• Promover a eficiência através da IA, por meio de propostas, homologações e apoio na implantação de melhorias sistêmicas ou de processos operacionais;

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.

Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.

Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.

Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.

Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.

Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.

Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).

Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: SR Desenvolvimento React Native + IA
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília

Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor React Native que não apenas construa interfaces, mas que entenda como integrar Inteligência Artificial no core do produto. O candidato ideal é um engenheiro \"AI-First\", que utiliza ferramentas como Cursor para acelerar o desenvolvimento e possui conhecimento profundo sobre como orquestrar Agentes de IA e gerenciar contexto via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Você trabalhará diretamente com Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) em especificações técnicas precisas que alimentam fluxos de codificação assistida por IA.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Mobile: Arquitetar e desenvolver aplicações escaláveis em React Native (iOS/Android) com TypeScript.
  • Integração de IA: Implementar funcionalidades que consomem LLMs, gerenciam estado de conversação e integram ferramentas externas via MCP.
  • Fluxo AI-First: Utilizar o editor Cursor como IDE principal, dominando a composição de contextos, regras de projeto (.cursorrules) e automação de refatoração.
  • Engenharia de Especificação: Atuar no modelo Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Ler o PRD, criar/refinar a Spec técnica e garantir que a implementação siga estritamente o contrato definido, utilizando IA para geração e validação de código.
  • Agentes Autônomos: Desenvolver ou integrar \"Agent Skills\" dentro do app, permitindo que o usuário interaja com agentes capazes de executar tarefas complexas (ex: buscar dados, agendar, analisar).
  • Qualidade: Garantir performance, acessibilidade e testes automatizados, validando o código gerado por IA.

Requisitos

  • React Native: Domínio avançado (Hooks, Performance, Native Modules, Reanimated).
  • TypeScript: Tipagem estrita e avançada.
  • Ecossistema de IA: Experiência prática com Cursor IDE (Composer, Chat, Rules).
  • Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol) para conexão de dados e ferramentas.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar).
  • Metodologia: Vivência com Spec-Driven Development ou trabalho orientado a contratos de interface/API.
  • Produto: Capacidade de ler e questionar PRDs, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.

Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.

Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior – Oracle Cloud
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados, com foco em arquitetura, integração e processamento de dados na Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em uma arquitetura medallion (Bronze, Prata e Ouro, , integrando fontes heterogêneas — incluindo Oracle Fusion Analytics, APIs, Bancos de Dados e plataformas diversas — garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das informações utilizadas pelas áreas de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados em ambientes Oracle Cloud, com foco em Oracle Cloud Data Integration e Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).

- Construir e gerenciar integrações de dados via APIs REST e ingestão de arquivos (CSV, JSON, XML, Parquet) a partir de fontes heterogêneas.

- Extrair e harmonizar dados do Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), consolidando informações financeiras e operacionais no Data Lake.

- Modelar e estruturar dados nas camadas analíticas para suportar soluções de BI e relatórios analíticos em Power BI.

- Trabalhar com processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT) respeitando a arquitetura de camadas do Data Lake.

- Apoiar a construção e manutenção do Catálogo de Dados no OCI, incluindo descoberta, linhagem e glossário.

- Garantir boas práticas de governança, qualidade e segurança de dados.

- Atuar em colaboração com times de arquitetura, analytics e áreas de negócio para entender demandas e propor soluções escaláveis.


Requisitos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

- Experiência com OCI Data Integration ou ferramenta equivalente de orquestração e transformação de dados em Oracle Cloud.

- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.

- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.

- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).

- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).

- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.

- Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas a dados (Python ou similar).


Diferenciais:

- Experiência com Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) — extração e entendimento do modelo de dados do Fusion.

- Vivência com Oracle Data Catalog para gestão de metadados e linhagem de dados.

- Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) para integração de sistemas.

- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados.


Modelo de Trabalho

- Remoto

- Contratação PJ


Benefícios ATRA:

- TotalPass

- Reembolso 100% em certificações

- Parcerias educacionais

- Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas

- Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

description:

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term (Through Dec 2026)

Work Schedule : 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location : 100% Remote


We are seeking a Junior Data Engineer with experience in Azure Databricks, Python, and Apache Spark to build and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions. title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $4,000 USD

Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Trading Systems to focus on the architecture, optimization, and development of their high-performance managed account platform. In this role, you will work on the computational core of the platform, designing and maintaining scalable backend services that power portfolio management and trading systems.

This position requires strong backend engineering and architectural expertise to translate complex business logic into efficient, production-grade code primarily using Python and C#/.NET Core. The ideal candidate excels at diagnosing and resolving performance bottlenecks and building reliable systems through rigorous code and systems analysis.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect and implement core platform logic, including high-throughput rebalancing and data processing services, using Python and C#/.NET Core.
  • Translate high-level functional requirements into clean, efficient, and testable backend code and microservices.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex performance and reliability issues by analyzing system architecture, algorithmic complexity, and code efficiency.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate core services into production-grade microservices and serverless workflows.
  • Build and optimize RESTful APIs that serve financial calculations and portfolio analytics.
  • Conduct code reviews focusing on architecture, correctness, efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Profile and optimize backend services to ensure sub-second response times for compute-intensive operations.
  • Write clear technical documentation in Confluence to explain complex system logic to cross-functional teams.
  • Implement serverless and scalable solutions using AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, and ECS, with a strong preference for Python-based implementations.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with product owners to align technical solutions with business needs.

Requirements for Success:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with significant experience in both C#/.NET Core and Python.
  • 4+ years working with relational databases, preferably SQL Server, including advanced query and schema optimization.
  • 4+ years developing cloud-native applications, preferably using AWS.
  • Proven experience as a senior backend engineer, driving design and best practices across multiple systems.
  • Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and computational complexity.
  • Familiarity with financial concepts such as rebalancing, asset allocation, and trade execution.
  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve performance issues through code profiling and optimization techniques.

Skills We Are Looking For:

  • Backend Engineering & Architecture:  C#, .NET Core, Python, serverless architectures, microservices architecture, and system design.
  • Problem Diagnosis:  Strong ability to identify system bottlenecks, analyze code efficiency, and clearly communicate technical problems.
  • Cloud Platforms:  Experience with AWS services, including Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, S3, and DynamoDB.
  • Database Proficiency:  Strong experience with SQL Server optimization and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • API Development:  Experience building RESTful web services, JSON APIs, and working with OpenAPI specifications.
  • Code Quality:  Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and continuous integration practices.
  • Communication:  Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts.
  • Collaboration:  Ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and business teams.

Bonus Items:

  • Experience with quantitative models for portfolio construction and optimization.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration.
  • AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect or Developer.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic.
  • Background in wealth management or FinTech systems.
  • Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers.

Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build high-performance trading systems at a leading fintech platform.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.
  • *Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Senior Executive Assistant | Senior Virtual Assistant
description:
Saleslights | Full-Time | Remote (Brazil Only)

Salary: 3,700 BRL/ month

Saleslights is looking for a bright, enthusiastic, vibrant, and highly organized Senior Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant to work directly with ambitious founders and senior sales leaders in the United States.

The ideal candidate is already active on LinkedIn , enjoys building their own professional brand, and is interested in sales, marketing, technology, and social selling .

You may already be posting insights, engaging with business content, or participating in conversations around:

• B2B sales

• marketing strategy

• technology

• entrepreneurship

A background in sales and marketing is highly valued for this role.

Additionally, the ideal candidate is a passionate and skilled video editor who enjoys producing their own short-form social media videos and understands the dynamics of modern vertical video content.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working closely with driven founders and elite sales professionals and thrives in a professional, fast-moving environment.

Overview:

Saleslights works with ambitious founders in the United States to help them build visibility, credibility, and authority through strategic communication and founder-led content.

Our clients are typically:

• cybersecurity founders

• B2B SaaS founders

• high-growth service company CEOs

They are visionary operators who move quickly and think strategically.

They do not need task managers.

They need someone who can manage communication, momentum, and execution around them.

Your role is to become the trusted operational partner for a small group of founders and senior / elite salespeople.

Your Mission:

You will manage up to three US founders or senior sales professionals and ensure they consistently complete a small number of high-impact activities each month.

Your job is to:

• organize communication

• keep projects moving

• motivate founder or sales leader participation

• maintain professional correspondence

• ensure key deliverables are completed

This role is closer to a Chief-of-Staff / Executive Assistant hybrid than a typical VA role.

Core Responsibilities:

You will manage the following for each founder or senior sales professional.

Founder Communication

Primary communication channel via email.

You will:

• write thoughtful, professional emails

• summarize discussions clearly

• guide founders or sales leaders toward next steps

• keep communication structured and calm

Expect to write long-form strategic emails , not quick chat replies.

Founder Momentum

Each month you will ensure founders or senior sales professionals complete:

• 2 short video recordings

• 5 document approvals

• up to 4 meetings

Your role is to:

• schedule

• follow up

• motivate

• remove friction

This requires strong soft leadership and persuasion skills .

Project Organization

title: [Tech] Especialista em Desenvolvimento Full Stack - .Net
description:
Descrição da vaga

Você terá a oportunidade de impactar diretamente o setor RH. Buscamos um(a) Especialista Full Stack com foco em IA com forte visão de arquitetura e inovação, que será responsável pela gestão e operação de um Consultor digital, atuando como ponto focal para iniciativas de experimentação e aplicação de tecnologias de IA. Este profissional terá como missão fomentar a cultura de IA, promover o uso ético e estratégico da IA, e apoiar colaboradores e equipes na exploração de soluções inteligentes que agreguem valor ao negócio.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Propor soluções conceituais e orientar a implementação de projetos de IA;
  • Experiência prática em projetos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural e/ou Visão Computacional;
  • Familiaridade com as capacidades e limitações da IA Generativa (ex: LLMs);
  • Integração de modelos de linguagem (LLMs) com APIs e sistemas legados;
  • Conhecimento prático de IA generativa e suas aplicações em negócios;
  • Integrar soluções de IA a sistemas corporativos de ERP, atuando no desenvolvimento back-end e front-end;
  • Implementar e validar POCs (provas de conceito) de novas tecnologias e soluções;
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Visão sistêmica: entender impactos das decisões técnicas no ecossistema como um todo;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a Squad conforme os processos ágeis definidos pela empresa, com objetivo de atingir as metas do time;
  • Garantir que as entregas estão em conformidade com as boas práticas e convenções internas;
  • Desenvolver Testes Unitários, Testes Automatizados e Documentar funcionalidades desenvolvidas;
  • Orientar e atuar junto ao time de desenvolvimento na definição de soluções de negócio e arquitetura, por meio de pesquisas e trocas de conhecimento com áreas parceiras.Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Boa lógica de programação e princípios SOLID;
  • Conhecimento em Back-end (c#, .Net, Advpl);
  • Conhecimento em Front-end (Angular/TypeScript);
  • Graduação completa em Computação, Engenharia, Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de IA/ML (NLP, LLMs, classificação e extração de entidades) e capacidade analítica para traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções de IA;
  • Engenharia de prompts, MCP, RAG, pipelines, modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados;
  • Experiência com projetos de IA Generativa;
  • Banco de Dados: SQL e NoSQL;
  • Controle de Versão: Git e ferramentas associadas (Repos, GitHub, GitLab);
  • APIs e configuração e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Noções de segurança da informação e boas práticas para desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Conhecimento em Processo Ágil, DevOps e plataformas Cloud (Azure).

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em Protheus;
  • Conhecimento em PO-UI.

Curte conversar, sabe negociar com respeito e não foge de uma conversa difícil? Então essa vaga pode ser a sua! No Juca, você vai atuar no atendimento com foco em cobrança, ajudando clientes a regularizar sua situação de forma simples, humana e sem burocracia.

⸻

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

• Atender clientes pelos canais oficiais, com foco em cobrança e negociação;

• Acompanhar pendências e apoiar na regularização de pagamentos;

• Tirar dúvidas sobre valores, prazos e formas de pagamento de um jeito claro e direto;

• Registrar os atendimentos e manter o histórico atualizado nos sistemas internos;

• Conduzir cada contato com empatia, agilidade e foco em solução;

• Contribuir para uma experiência de atendimento respeitosa e eficiente.

⸻

O que a gente busca em você

• Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;

• Organização e atenção aos detalhes;

• Jogo de cintura para negociar e contornar objeções com respeito;

• Proatividade e foco em resolução;

• Facilidade com ferramentas digitais e sistemas de atendimento;

• Experiência com atendimento ou cobrança será um diferencial.

⸻

Benefícios: Pacote de Remuneração Competitivo

Modelo: 100% Home Office

Curtiu e se identificou?

Candidate-se e venha fazer parte de um time que tá mudando o jeito de fazer crédito no Brasil.

Juca. Crédito 100% digital e sem burocracias.

title: Engenheiro Mecânico HVAC
description:
A Sampaio Engenharia Térmica está expandindo seu time técnico em Cuiabá - MT ! Buscamos um Engenheiro Mecânico especialista em sistemas de climatização (HVAC) para atuar desde o desenvolvimento de projetos até o acompanhamento em campo. Se você é um profissional focado em qualidade técnica e conformidade, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe. Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Desenvolvimento e dimensionamento completo de sistemas HVAC;
  • Elaboração de cálculos de carga térmica e especificações técnicas;
  • Interpretação de projetos e compatibilização com outras disciplinas de engenharia;
  • Acompanhamento técnico da instalação e execução em campo;
  • Garantia da conformidade dos serviços com as normas técnicas vigentes;
  • Suporte técnico especializado e emissão de relatórios de acompanhamento.
Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Formação: Graduação completa em Engenharia Mecânica;
  • Experiência: Sólida experiência com projetos e execução de sistemas HVAC;
  • Softwares: Domínio indispensável de AutoCAD e Revit (BIM);
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Profundo conhecimento em normas técnicas aplicáveis ao setor de climatização.
Benefícios
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Prêmio Assiduidade;
  • Salário: A combinar.
Local de Trabalho
  • Cuiabá - MT
Como se candidatar?
  • Interessados devem enviar o currículo para o e-mail: ou entrar em contato pelo WhatsApp: (65) .

title: Node.js Data Engineer (TypeScript) - Remote (Brazil)
description:
Position: Node.js Data Engineer (TypeScript)

Location: Remote – Brazil

Job Type: Contract

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Node.js and TypeScript , along with experience in data engineering, database management, and data modeling .

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize scalable data solutions that support business and analytics needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize backend services using Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Design, implement, and maintain databases and data pipelines .
  • Perform data modeling, data transformation, and system integrations .
  • Collaborate with data architects, analysts, and software engineers to deliver high-quality data solutions.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize data workflows for performance and scalability .
  • Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of software development experience with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and data modeling .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, backend architecture, and data integration patterns .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment .
  • Excellent communication skills in English or Portuguese .

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with ETL pipelines and data warehousing solutions .
  • Familiarity with GraphQL or REST API development .
  • Knowledge of data governance, data security, and compliance .

title: Business Systems Administrator
description:
Business Systems Administrator

Location : Remote (Brazil)

About Sphise Technologies

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling its operational systems ecosystem and is seeking a Business Systems Administrator to support the stability, integration, and growth of its core business platforms. As the organisation expands, this role will play a key part in ensuring systems remain reliable, integrated, and optimised while supporting AI-enabled workflows and operational efficiency.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Business Systems Administrator to support the daily operation, optimization, and expansion of core business systems. This contractor role will serve as a central technical and strategic partner to Business Operations, ensuring that the organization’s systems ecosystem remains stable, integrated, scalable, and capable of supporting future growth. This role requires experience managing multiple interconnected platforms, building integrations and APIs, and implementing automation and AI-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making. Core systems include platforms such as HubSpot, Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , and other operational and revenue tools.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage the day-to-day administration and performance of core business systems
  • Maintain system access, permissions, and overall platform reliability
  • Build and maintain integrations and APIs across CRM, revenue, and operational systems
  • Troubleshoot system issues and ensure reliable data flow between platforms
  • Support the implementation of automation and AI-powered workflows
  • Assist with onboarding and rollout of new tools and platforms
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and reporting across systems
  • Partner with internal teams to improve processes and system efficiency.

What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience managing business systems in a SaaS or high-growth environment
  • Strong experience administering CRM and revenue platforms (HubSpot required)
  • Proven experience building and managing APIs and system integrations
  • Experience working with multi-system ecosystems
  • Hands-on experience implementing automation or AI-enabled tools
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural mindset
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and focus on data integrity
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , or similar revenue operations tools
  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools such as Zapier, Make, or Workato
  • Experience supporting Customer Success and Revenue Operations teams
  • Background in process optimization and change management
  • Experience working in private equity-backed or rapidly scaling organizations.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer (ISV / OEM Application)
description:
Company Overview

QAT Global is a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience delivering high-quality technology solutions to enterprise clients. Our teams operate across the United States, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to design, develop, and maintain a commercial Salesforce OEM/ISV application .

This role involves building scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex and Lightning Web Components while supporting managed package development and AppExchange distribution.

The professional will work directly with US-based clients and collaborate with distributed engineering teams.

Core Technical Skills

  • Apex development
  • Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • SOQL / SOSL
  • Salesforce Flows
  • Apex Triggers
  • Salesforce data modeling

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable Salesforce application features
  • Build advanced automation using Flows and Apex
  • Maintain and extend managed packages
  • Ensure compliance with Salesforce governor limits and security models
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and release management
  • Implement integrations and data migration processes
  • Collaborate with product managers and client technical teams

Required Experience

  • Strong Salesforce development experience with Apex and LWC
  • Experience combining declarative configuration and custom development
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce security and sharing models
  • Experience with CI/CD and version control
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with managed packages or ISV applications
  • Experience with Experience Cloud / Community Cloud
  • Familiarity with backend systems such as C# or .NET

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder

Additional Requirements

  • Professional English communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate with distributed teams

title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Senior Azure DevOps Infrastructure Engineer

High-Traffic Drupal | Azure Web Apps | US Client (EST)

Long-term Contract | Remote (EST Hours) | Rate DOE

The Mission

Stabilize and optimize a production Drupal site on Azure Web Apps facing deployment failures and performance bottlenecks. Partner with their Senior Drupal dev to own all Azure infrastructure + DevOps . Immediate impact required , no ramp-up time.

Experience Needed

  • 5+ years Azure infrastructure/DevOps
  • 2+ years production Azure Web App Services hosting high-traffic Drupal CMS (100k+ users)
  • Proven track record of blue-green deployments rescuing troubled web applications

Must-Have Skills

  • Production Azure Web Apps (Bitbucket syncs, Oryx builds, deployment slots)
  • Drupal operations (drush rsync, updb/cim against production DBs)
  • Azure Database management (snapshots, point-in-time restores)
  • Performance optimization (maintenance mode, Redis cache management)
  • Blue-green deployment execution (smoke tests, log analysis, zero-downtime swaps)

Bonus Points

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)
  • Drupal/Drush hands-on (config management, module deployments)
  • High-traffic optimization (sub-2s page loads under load)

Why This Role

  • 40hr/wk EST working with US consultancy (public/private/federal sectors)
  • Long-term contract with proven follow-on project pipeline
  • Single point of failure rescue → become their go-to Azure/Drupal partner

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Who we are

We’re a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we’ll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let’s see what we can accomplish together!

Your role

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll be leading a full stack or backend team focused on one of the key opportunities for Playlist.

You will:

  • Empower your engineering team to deliver a high level of technical quality and business impact.
  • Recruit a diverse team of engineers that are amongst the best in the industry, from outreach to closing.
  • Manage a team of engineers and help develop their careers with stretch responsibilities and excellent feedback.
  • Be actively involved in strategic direction and product decisions for your team.
  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Playlist's engineering management team.

About the right team member

You are an experienced engineer turned successful people leader who is passionate about creating impactful and high-quality web applications. You have deep experience in at least one aspect of developing a world class web application and you can manage a high performing team through the entire process.

You’ll thrive in this role with experience in:

  • 3+ years of directly managing a full stack or backend engineering team of at least 6 people.
  • Experience shipping high quality websites or mobile applications.
  • You have established the architecture and best practices for web or mobile applications and their backends.
  • You have a proven ability to establish and articulate a vision, set goals, develop and execute.

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:

HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.

We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .

Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.

If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!

Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Líder de Ongoing
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Líder de Ongoing para conduzir a operação de pós-onboarding, garantindo retenção, engajamento e geração contínua de valor para clientes da área da saúde. Esse profissional liderará o time de Ongoing e atuará de forma integrada com Produto, Comercial, Suporte e Onboarding, assegurando a evolução dos processos e a excelência no relacionamento com os clientes.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar o time de Ongoing, orientando prioridades, rotinas e boas práticas;
  • Garantir a execução consistente da estratégia de pós-onboarding, focada em adoção, engajamento e retenção;
  • Conduzir ritos de acompanhamento: alinhamentos semanais, health check de carteira, forecast e QBRs internos;
  • Monitorar indicadores como churn, retenção, engajamento, NPS e oportunidades de expansão;
  • Atuar diretamente em contas estratégicas ou sensíveis;
  • Apoiar a melhoria contínua de processos, playbooks e documentação da área;
  • Conduzir feedbacks, desenvolvimento e treinamentos do time;
  • Atuar como ponte entre Ongoing, Produto, Comercial, Suporte e Onboarding;
  • Garantir uma comunicação clara, empática e consultiva com clientes do setor da saúde.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas como Administração, Gestão, Comunicação, Tecnologia ou correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em Customer Success Ongoing / Pós-vendas em empresas de tecnologia;
  • Experiência inicial em liderança de pessoas ou coordenação de processos;
  • Vivência com métricas de CS e gestão de carteira;
  • Boa capacidade de organização, comunicação e priorização.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Visão consultiva;
  • Empatia;
  • Assertividade;
  • Senso de responsabilidade;
  • Pensamento orientado a dados;
  • Escuta ativa;
  • Capacidade de ensinar.

Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

title: Editorial Graphic Designer (Interiors + Spaces)
description:
So… who the heck is Residence Supply?

I'm Jacky, the founder. We started as a local lighting brand obsessed with historical architecture and heirloom craftsmanship. In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.

Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. We need a graphic designer who doesn't just execute... but one who sees the world the way our customers do. Through the lens of beauty, heritage, and taste.

What You'll Do

  • Design editorial ads that feel like they were pulled from a print magazine
  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint
  • Collaborate with our Creative Strategist, Content team, and Founder on campaign ideation
  • QC all outgoing creative. Nothing ships unless it looks like Residence Supply

Who You Are

  • 3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
  • Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
  • Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
  • You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
  • Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.

What We're Building

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.

This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.

What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
  • Fully remote

How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

  • A portfolio or 3–5 pieces you're most proud of... especially anything editorial, catalog, or interiors-adjacent please!
  • A quick paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of a Residence Supply print catalog
  • Tell us: what brand's visual identity do you wish you had built and why?

If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Good luck.

description:

About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.

Role Description:

Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. title: PLM Architect
description:
About us :

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.

Responsibilities

  • You will lead and/or support consulting services and implementation projects for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) using PTC Windchill Product suite.
  • You will analyze customers’ business requirements and successfully implement solutions as part of a cross-functional team.
  • You will lead and/or participate in, assist with, or act as the facilitator in workshops/work sessions.
  • You will support the definition of client-specific solutions for PLM, including application and technical architecture.
  • You will help our customers realize value faster by optimizing OOTB solutions and redefining processes, as needed.
  • You will execute assigned project tasks for planning, analysis, development, and testing.
  • You will execute technical tasks including the installation and configuration of PLM software, assessing gaps between requirements and software functionality and define appropriate path forward debugging, data migration, infrastructure, and deployment support.
  • You will ensure quality through established software engineering methods and processes.
  • You will be a valued project team contributor by demonstrating an ability to balance independent work practices with appropriate levels of communication across a broad spectrum of project stakeholders.
  • You will manage commitments within a flexible work schedule.

Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Strong PLM domain knowledge
  • Proven experience on delivering PLM solutions to customers
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Knowledge of PTC Windchill Product suites desired.
  • Be able to work autonomously and focus on goals.
  • Be customer service oriented.
  • Have programming skills, preferably in Java.
  • A desire to continue your professional growth through formal and on-the-job ongoing product and consulting skills training.

Must Have Skills

  • 5-10+ years’ experience in PLM, preferably PTC Windchill Product suite.
  • Participated in PLM Implementation projects.
  • Educational background in Engineering or Computer Science (bachelor’s or master’s Degree Level)
  • Languages: Advanced or Fluent Proficiency level (written and spoken) in English and Spanish.
  • Willingness to travel, as needed

ITC Infotech is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences, such as age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, religion, or sexual orientation. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. title: Business Development Representative
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.

We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:

Role Overview

We are looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) / Sales Representative to drive outbound sales and generate new business opportunities. The ideal candidate will be responsible for prospecting, outreach, and lead generation, helping expand our client base for software and engineering services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect potential clients through LinkedIn, email outreach, cold calling, and other outbound channels
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified leads
  • Conduct initial discovery calls to understand client needs
  • Schedule meetings and demos for senior sales or technical teams
  • Maintain CRM records and track outreach activities
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to improve outreach strategies
  • Research target industries and companies to identify potential opportunities
  • Achieve and exceed monthly lead generation and pipeline targets

Requirements

  • 2+ years experience in business development, sales, or lead generation
  • Experience in B2B outbound sales
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Experience using CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)
  • Ability to manage high-volume outreach campaigns
  • Self-motivated with strong organizational skills

description:
